title: varco run report JSON
description: The machine-readable report written by `varco run --format json`. The envelope is versioned by schema_version; additive changes keep it at 1.

schema_version.description: The version of the document shape. Always 1: an additive change does not bump it.

verdict.description: The aggregate outcome of the run (ADR 0007).

repeat.description: The --repeat value this run used. An additive field, so a consumer must accept a document without it.

body_policy.description: The --body policy in force. An additive field, so a consumer must accept a document without it.

excluded.description: The cases removed by --family or --exclude-path before the run. An additive field, so a consumer must accept a document without it.

unsupported_count.description: The number of unsupported findings in the plan.

unsupported.description: The unsupported findings of the plan.

expired_exceptions.description: The ids of the exceptions that are past their expires date.

ignored_fields.description: The fields left out of every comparison, reported so nothing is invisible.

cases.description: One evaluation per case, in plan order.

redacted.description: True unless --show-sensitive was used. An additive field, so a consumer must accept a document without it.

coverage.description: How much of the plan the run observed (ADR 0007).

planned.description: The number of cases in the plan.

executed.description: The number of cases the run observed, planned minus skipped.

skipped.description: The number of cases the run did not observe.

evaluation.description: The complete result of one executed case.

case_id.description: The id of the case in the plan.

differences.description: Every observed difference, accepted ones included.

explanations.description: The known migration behaviors that explain the differences. An additive field, so a consumer must accept a document without it.

error.description: Why the case could not be observed.

difference.description: One observed mismatch and the policy decision about it.

code.description: The stable diagnostic code, for example VAR-CMP-0001.

field.description: The compared field, for example status or header.location.

old.description: The value observed on the old endpoint, redacted unless --show-sensitive was used.

new.description: The value observed on the new endpoint, redacted unless --show-sensitive was used.

accepted.description: True when policy accepted the difference.

exception_id.description: The exception that accepted the difference.

explanation.description: A known migration behavior that can explain a difference.

id.description: The rule id of the explanation.

finding.description: Something varco could not plan or test, with the reason why.

code.description: The stable diagnostic code, for example VAR-PLAN-0001.

ingress.description: The Ingress the finding refers to.

annotation.description: The annotation the finding refers to.

path.description: The path the finding refers to.

message.description: What varco could not do, and why.
